decisions.reason: The source defines persistent hover-label text and purpose but does not change whether placeholder text automatically clears when a field is activated.
Persistent hover labels can accompany the editable controls without changing their mechanism, robustness, intended use, or legacy-field handling.
The field-label clarification does not alter the required style source, template-wide style coverage, or listed style additions.
Hover-label behavior for interactive fields is unrelated to manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source does not change any bullet appearance, alignment, scaling, color, or level requirement.
The product-level field-label clarification does not change the task-local assessment process or its deliverables.
The source concerns help-label wording and persistence, not the controlled theme-color palette.
The field-label rule does not alter legacy copy-paste behavior, test sources, target version, or the existing workflow ambiguity.
The source does not address Tab-controlled list levels, hierarchy alignment, or the unresolved list-entry workflow.
Interactive-field help labels do not change table or column stability during pasted-content workflows.
The source changes a field-label behavior but does not change the requested package contents or delivery condition.
The field-label clarification does not modify heading emphasis, title size, typography, or style spacing.
